name: (Worm That Walks) Squirming Embrace
text: The worm that walks Strides, ending its movement sharing a space with a creature, and deals piercing damage to the creature equal to 1d8 piercing plus an additional 1d8 for every 3 levels the worm that walks has. The creature can attempt a basic Reflex save save with a DC of the worm that walks's spell DC - 2.
